draft.title: The idea of quantisation
card: A quantity is quantised when it comes only in set amounts, like steps on a staircase. It cannot take any value in between.
Planck and Einstein showed that light energy comes in packets called photons. One photon of frequency f has energy E = hf, where h is Planck's constant.
A higher frequency means a larger energy for each photon. Brighter light of the same frequency means more photons, not more energy in each one.
The same idea explained atoms. Electrons in an atom can have only certain set amounts of energy, not any amount.
draft.remember: Energy comes in set packets, and E = hf gives the size of one photon.

a.q: What does it mean to say the energy of light is quantised?
opts: It comes in packets, each of a set size for a frequency
It can take any value, but only in very bright light
It travels as a wave that has no smallest amount
It is shared equally between all the photons in a beam
a.why: Quantised means energy comes in set amounts. For light, each photon of a given frequency carries E = hf. The option about any value is wrong because it describes energy without steps.
a.clue: Think of steps on a staircase, not a ramp.

b.q: Two beams of light of the same frequency fall on a surface. Beam X is twice as bright as beam Y. How do the photons in the beams compare?
opts: X has more photons each second, with the same energy each
X has the same number of photons, each with twice the energy
X has more photons each second, each with twice the energy
X has the same number of photons, each with the same energy
b.why: Photon energy depends only on frequency, E = hf, and the frequencies are equal. A brighter beam has more photons each second. Doubling the energy of each photon would need a higher frequency, not more brightness.
b.clue: What does the energy of one photon depend on?

a.best: It comes in packets, each of a set size for a frequency

b.best: X has more photons each second, with the same energy each

problems.detail: 'Planck and Einstein showed that light energy comes in packets called photons' overstates Planck's role. Planck quantised the energy of the oscillators that emit radiation. Einstein (1905) proposed that light itself comes in quanta, and the word 'photon' came later. Suggest: 'Planck proposed that energy is quantised, and Einstein showed that light energy comes in packets, later called photons.'

check.summary: Both questions are sound and each has one clear right answer. One small historical inaccuracy: the card credits Planck with showing that light comes in photons, which was Einstein's idea.
